title: Fundamental Structure
description: A complete visual construction of the supplied Static and Dynamic Aspects using one persistent o/x transformation alphabet.

scenes.title: One thing
scenes.subtitle: Introduce o without spatial interpretation.
scenes.narration: Introduce o without spatial interpretation.

scenes.title: Another thing
scenes.subtitle: Introduce x because repetition of o cannot distinguish.
scenes.narration: Introduce x because repetition of o cannot distinguish.

scenes.title: This and that
scenes.subtitle: Priority, not location, differentiates two things.
scenes.narration: Priority, not location, differentiates two things.

scenes.title: Difference as operation
scenes.subtitle: o and x define the invariant transformation between them.
scenes.narration: o and x define the invariant transformation between them.

scenes.title: First and second
scenes.subtitle: oo and ox secure precedence without location.
scenes.narration: oo and ox secure precedence without location.

scenes.title: The tetrad
scenes.subtitle: Four symbols support three independent pairings.
scenes.narration: Four symbols support three independent pairings.

scenes.title: Row, column, diagonal
scenes.subtitle: Derive the three mutually independent interchanges.
scenes.narration: Derive the three mutually independent interchanges.

scenes.title: Four-member thing
scenes.subtitle: Superpose zero and three interchange operations.
scenes.narration: Superpose zero and three interchange operations.

scenes.title: Sixteen-member reflexion
scenes.subtitle: A tetrad of tetrads repeats the same structure.
scenes.narration: A tetrad of tetrads repeats the same structure.

scenes.title: Indefinite expansion
scenes.subtitle: 4,16,64,256… members arise recursively.
scenes.narration: 4,16,64,256… members arise recursively.

scenes.title: Invariant whole
scenes.subtitle: Any member transformation permutes the set without changing it.
scenes.narration: Any member transformation permutes the set without changing it.

scenes.title: Structure of structure
scenes.subtitle: Immediate and reflexive structure share one form.
scenes.narration: Immediate and reflexive structure share one form.

scenes.title: Infinite hierarchy
scenes.subtitle: Particular/general and reflexive hierarchies extend indefinitely.
scenes.narration: Particular/general and reflexive hierarchies extend indefinitely.

scenes.title: Duration
scenes.subtitle: Unchange and change are one invariant transformation.
scenes.narration: Unchange and change are one invariant transformation.

scenes.title: Repeated moments
scenes.subtitle: Column interchange repeats while the whole remains unchanged.
scenes.narration: Column interchange repeats while the whole remains unchanged.

scenes.title: No finite duration
scenes.subtitle: Two rates of change do not produce true duration.
scenes.narration: Two rates of change do not produce true duration.

scenes.title: Accelerating infinity
scenes.subtitle: Infinite moments converge by geometric acceleration.
scenes.narration: Infinite moments converge by geometric acceleration.

scenes.title: Three temporal levels
scenes.subtitle: Eternal, regular and accelerating levels coexist.
scenes.narration: Eternal, regular and accelerating levels coexist.

scenes.title: No absolute outside
scenes.subtitle: The hierarchy extends both ways with no universal present.
scenes.narration: The hierarchy extends both ways with no universal present.

scenes.title: Irreversible alternation
scenes.subtitle: o vanishes, x becomes the new o; the system is not reversible.
scenes.narration: o vanishes, x becomes the new o; the system is not reversible.

scenes.title: Intensity hierarchy
scenes.subtitle: This has weight 2/3 and that 1/3; lower orders sum to unity.
scenes.narration: This has weight 2/3 and that 1/3; lower orders sum to unity.

scenes.title: Generality as time
scenes.subtitle: Nested squares alternate between depth hierarchy and temporal corridor.
scenes.narration: Nested squares alternate between depth hierarchy and temporal corridor.

scenes.title: Past-present-future
scenes.subtitle: All exist in the present as over-, fully-, and under-determined.
scenes.narration: All exist in the present as over-, fully-, and under-determined.

scenes.title: Three weighted interchanges
scenes.subtitle: One this remains invariant while three thats vary.
scenes.narration: One this remains invariant while three thats vary.

scenes.title: Identity by negation
scenes.subtitle: The chair remains chair through shifting relative determinations.
scenes.narration: The chair remains chair through shifting relative determinations.

scenes.title: Selection by repeated squaring
scenes.subtitle: Weights 3:2:1 become 9:4:1, then 81:16:1 until one operation dominates.
scenes.narration: Weights 3:2:1 become 9:4:1, then 81:16:1 until one operation dominates.

scenes.title: Unfinished frontier
scenes.subtitle: Intention, action and choice require the continuation.
